reason: A Markdown-first visual workflow editor that synchronizes workflow documents with an interactive canvas and supports Boolean gate validation plus reviewed AI-assisted optimization; it is an editor rather than a workflow runtime.

summaries.zh: 一个以 Markdown 为基础的可视化工作流编辑器，可在画布与工作流文档之间同步编辑，并提供布尔门验证和经审查的 AI 优化辅助。
summaries.en: A Markdown-first visual workflow editor that synchronizes an interactive canvas with workflow documents and provides Boolean gate validation and reviewed AI-assisted optimization.

capabilities: Creates and updates Markdown workflow documents
Provides a visual canvas for editing workflow nodes and connections
Evaluates Boolean gate logic without executing Agent steps
Requests Agent review or optimization of workflow changes
Can delete managed workflows or templates with confirmation
